command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: scripts/zoneRules/parseZoneTable.ts:37 declares a private `function parseCoordinates(text: string, lineNumber: number): ZoneTenths` that parses ISO 6709 zone-table text into tenths, while docs/glossary/locations.md:7 names `parseCoordinates` in `src/model/coordinates.ts` as the Code: owner of Coordinates (validates an unknown value into `Coordinates | undefined`). .claude/rules/glossary.md: 'Do not write a new function, type or constant for the same concept anywhere else' / 'A name that carries a glossary concept under a different word is a bug'. Two unrelated functions now share the owner's name; rename the script helper (e.g. `parseZoneTableCoordinates`).

packages/client/src/views/shared/LocationSearch.tsx was touched by this change (lines 40-45 pass `coordinates: result.coordinates` to `addLocation`, task 8.1) but carries no traceability reference to add-city-coordinates-to-locations. tasks.md: 'Every new or touched production file gets a JSDoc line `Implements <ids> of add-city-coordinates-to-locations (D<n>).`' Add e.g. 'Implements FR6 of add-city-coordinates-to-locations (D6)'.

docs/glossary/locations.md:7 **Coordinates** entry drifts from the proposal's definition. proposal.md 'What Changes' says: 'the latitude and longitude of a place in decimal degrees, north and east positive, rounded to 0.1°; carried by a city record and by a city location'. The entry omits 'rounded to 0.1°' and says only 'A city location may carry them', not that a city record carries them.
